content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering an issue where, when I click the icon to upload or download a program between my PC and the [product_name], the [product_name] engineering software becomes unresponsive and displays a blue spinning circle for about 30 seconds before the dialog finally appears. This occurs in both [version_no] 8.3 and 8.4. On a different PC, the dialog shows up in about 2 seconds without delay. Do you have any suggestions about what could be causing this? I've also tried reinstalling Java. Thanks.
Submit a support request for further assistance.
Issue resolved — the delay was caused by a large number of virtual COM ports linked to Bluetooth devices in the system manager.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced substantial delays (about 30 seconds) when transferring programs between a PC and [product_name], using [product_name] engineering software version 8.3 and 8.4. On another PC, the dialog opened almost instantly, indicating a performance and compatibility issue connected to system configuration, specifically due to multiple virtual COM ports assigned to Bluetooth devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the upload and download dialog to open within a few seconds, allowing fast and smooth program transfers.
